# Krithik Tours & Travels

> Krithik Tours & Travels is a trusted travel agency based in Palani, Tamil Nadu, offering curated tour packages across South India. Specializing in temple tours, hill station getaways, Kerala backwater experiences, and NRI pilgrimage tours, the company provides end-to-end travel services including hotel stays, private drivers, airport/railway pickup and drop, and family-safe transportation. With 20+ destinations, 500+ happy travelers, and a 5-star rating, Krithik Tours & Travels is committed to comfort travel for every guest.

## AEO Questions (40 High-Searchable Questions)

### Palani Temple Tours
Q: How much does a one-day Palani temple trip cost?
A: The Palani One Day Trip costs ₹4,999 and includes a driver-cum-guide, toll charges, hotel accommodation, and pickup/drop anywhere in Tamil Nadu. The tour covers Palani Hill Temple, Thiruavinanagudi, Mariyamman Kovil, Periya Nayaki Amman Kovil, Periyaudaiyar Kovil, Saakkadai Sithar Kovil, and more.

Q: What is the best time to visit Palani Murugan Temple?
A: The best time to visit Palani Murugan Temple is during the cooler months from October to March. Early morning darshan at 6:00 AM is recommended for a peaceful experience. The temple is one of the six abodes (Arupadai Veedu) of Lord Murugan.

Q: How do I reach Palani Murugan Temple?
A: Palani is well-connected by road and rail. Krithik Tours & Travels offers pickup from anywhere in Tamil Nadu, including railway junctions, bus stands, and hotels. The temple is located on a hill and can be reached by steps, winch, or rope car.

Q: What are the Arupadai Veedu (six abodes of Lord Murugan)?
A: The six abodes are Palani, Pazhamudircholai, Thiruparankundram, Thiruchendur, Swamimalai, and Tiruttani. Krithik Tours & Travels offers a 3-day Arupadai Veedu tour covering all six temples with private car, hotel accommodation, and driver included.

Q: How long does the Arupadai Veedu Murugan temple tour take?
A: The Arupadai Veedu tour is a 3-day, 2-night journey. Day 1 covers Palani, Pazhamudircholai, and Thiruparankundram with a night stay in Madurai. Day 2 covers Thiruchendur and Swamimalai with a night in Thanjavur. Day 3 covers Tiruttani before returning home.

### Kodaikanal Tours
Q: What is the price of a Kodaikanal tour package?
A: Kodaikanal weekend trip (3 days/2 nights) costs ₹14,999 and the holiday package costs ₹22,999. Both include star hotel accommodation, driver-cum-guide, airport/railway pickup and drop, toll charges, and family-safe travel.

Q: What are the top places to visit in Kodaikanal?
A: Top attractions include Kodai Lake, Bryant Park, Coaker's Walk, Pillar Rocks, Guna Caves (Devil's Kitchen), Green Valley View (Suicide Point), Bear Shola Falls, Pine Forest, Kurinji Andavar Temple, Silver Cascade Falls, Dolphin Nose viewpoint, and Berijam Lake.

Q: How many days are enough for Kodaikanal?
A: A 3-day, 2-night trip is ideal for Kodaikanal. Day 1 covers the lake and viewpoints, Day 2 covers Pillar Rocks, Guna Caves, and waterfalls, and Day 3 covers Berijam Lake, Silver Cascade Falls, and shopping for homemade chocolates.

Q: What is the best time to visit Kodaikanal?
A: The best time to visit Kodaikanal is from September to May when the weather is pleasant. Avoid heavy monsoon months (June-August) as landslides can occur. The hill station sits at 2,133 meters in the Palani Hills.

Q: How far is Kodaikanal from Palani?
A: Kodaikanal is approximately 80 km from Palani by road, with a scenic hill drive taking about 2-3 hours. Krithik Tours & Travels provides pickup from Palani and drives you directly to Kodaikanal.

### Yercaud Tours
Q: What is the cost of a Yercaud tour package?
A: The Yercaud weekend package (3 days/2 nights) costs ₹12,999 and the holiday package costs ₹20,999. Both include hotel stay, driver-cum-guide, pickup and drop, and toll charges.

Q: What are the best places to visit in Yercaud?
A: Top attractions in Yercaud include Yercaud Lake, Anna Park, Lady's Seat viewpoint, Shevaroy Temple (highest point), Killiyur Falls, Pagoda Point, Bear Cave, coffee plantations, Botanical Garden, Deer Park, Rose Garden, and Gents Seat viewpoint.

Q: Why is Yercaud called the Poor Man's Ooty?
A: Yercaud is called the Poor Man's Ooty because it offers a similar hill station experience to Ooty but at a more affordable price. Located at 1,515 meters in the Shevaroy Hills near Salem, it is budget-friendly and less crowded.

Q: How do I reach Yercaud from Salem?
A: Yercaud is about 30 km from Salem and is reached via 20 hairpin bends. Krithik Tours & Travels offers pickup from Salem railway station or your home and drives you safely through the scenic ghat road to Yercaud.

### Munnar Tours
Q: What is the price of a Munnar tour package from Tamil Nadu?
A: The Munnar weekend package (3 days/2 nights) costs ₹14,999 and the holiday package costs ₹22,999. Both include hotel accommodation, driver-cum-guide, pickup and drop anywhere in Tamil Nadu, and toll charges.

Q: What are the top tourist places in Munnar?
A: Top attractions in Munnar include Cheeyappara Waterfalls, Valara Waterfalls, Tea Museum, Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, Kundala Lake, Photo Point, Eravikulam National Park (Nilgiri Tahr sanctuary), Top Station, and Attukal Waterfalls.

Q: What is special about Munnar tea gardens?
A: Munnar is famous for its sweeping tea plantations covering rolling hills at 1,600 meters elevation. The Tata Tea legacy, colonial-era tea estates, and the Tea Museum offer visitors a chance to learn about tea-making processes and purchase fresh tea and spices.

Q: When does the Neelakurinji flower bloom in Munnar?
A: The Neelakurinji flower blooms once every 12 years in Munnar, covering the hills in purple-blue blossoms. The last bloom was in 2018, making the next expected bloom around 2030. Eravikulam National Park is the best place to witness this phenomenon.

### Ooty Tours
Q: What is the cost of an Ooty tour package?
A: The Ooty weekend package (3 days/2 nights) costs ₹14,999 and the holiday package costs ₹23,999. Both include hotel stay, driver-cum-guide, pickup and drop, and toll charges.

Q: What are the Ooty toy train timings?
A: The Nilgiri Mountain Railway toy train runs from Mettupalayam to Ooty and Coonoor to Ooty. Timings vary by season. Detailed schedules, ticket prices, and booking tips are available in our Ooty Toy Train Timings 2027 guide on the blog.

Q: What are the top places to visit in Ooty?
A: Top Ooty attractions include Government Botanical Gardens, Ooty Lake, Rose Garden (Asia's largest), Coonoor, Sim's Park, Dolphin's Nose, Lamb's Rock, Tea Factory and Museum, Doddabetta Peak (highest in Nilgiris), Pykara Lake and Waterfalls, and Avalanche Lake.

### Mysore Tours
Q: What is the price of a Mysore tour package?
A: The Mysore weekend package (3 days/2 nights) costs ₹14,999 and the holiday package costs ₹22,999. Both include hotel accommodation, driver-cum-guide, pickup and drop anywhere in Tamil Nadu, and toll charges.

Q: What are the best places to visit in Mysore?
A: Top Mysore attractions include Mysore Palace, Chamundi Hills, Chamundeshwari Temple, giant Nandi statue, Brindavan Gardens with musical fountain, Mysore Zoo, St. Philomena's Cathedral, Jaganmohan Palace Art Gallery, Railway Museum, Sand Sculpture Museum, Srirangapatna, and Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace.

Q: When is the Mysore Dasara festival celebrated?
A: Mysore Dasara is a 10-day festival typically celebrated in September or October. The Mysore Palace is illuminated with thousands of lights, and a grand procession with decorated elephants passes through the city. It is Karnataka's state festival (Nada Habba).

### Kerala Tours (Alleppey Houseboat)
Q: How much does an Alleppey houseboat stay cost?
A: The Alleppey Boat Stay package costs ₹14,999 for one night on a traditional Kerala houseboat. The package includes pickup and drop, driver-cum-guide, and family-safe travel. The houseboat cruise covers Vembanad Lake, sunset viewing, and village visits.

Q: What is included in an Alleppey houseboat stay?
A: The houseboat stay includes welcome drink, lunch onboard, traditional Kerala dinner, overnight stay with all amenities, morning breakfast, cruise through Vembanad Lake backwaters, sunset viewing, and visits to local villages and coir-making units.

Q: How many days are needed for an Alleppey houseboat trip?
A: A 2-day, 1-night trip is ideal for the Alleppey houseboat experience. Day 1 includes arrival, houseboat check-in, backwater cruise, sunset, and overnight stay. Day 2 includes morning views, breakfast, village exploration, Alleppey Beach visit, and return journey.

### Coorg Tours
Q: What is the price of a Coorg tour package?
A: The Coorg weekend package (3 days/2 nights) costs ₹14,999 and the holiday package costs ₹22,999. Both include resort/homestay accommodation, driver-cum-guide, pickup and drop anywhere in Tamil Nadu, and toll charges.

Q: What are the top places to visit in Coorg?
A: Top Coorg attractions include Coffee Plantation, Raja's Seat sunset viewpoint, Abbey Falls, Omkareshwara Temple, Madikeri Fort and Museum, Dubare Elephant Camp, River Kaveri, Golden Temple (Namdroling Monastery), Talacauvery (origin of River Kaveri), Bhagamandala Temple, and Iruppu Falls.

### Valparai Tours
Q: What is the cost of a Valparai tour package?
A: The Valparai weekend package (3 days/2 nights) costs ₹14,999 and the holiday package costs ₹22,999. Both include hotel accommodation, driver-cum-guide, pickup and drop, and toll charges.

Q: What is special about Valparai?
A: Valparai is a tea estate hill station in the Annamalai Hills of Tamil Nadu, reached via 40 hairpin bends. It is known for tea plantations, wildlife spotting (bison and elephants), Athirapally Waterfalls, Nallamudi Viewpoint, Sholayar Dam, Aliyar Dam, Monkey Falls, and Grass Hills trekking.
